cause: Async CONFIG/AutoEq/STFT/sequence/preset handlers dereferenced panel.webview after disposal. Catch handlers repeated the disposed getter and raised a global Webview is disposed notification. Rejected postMessage thenables were also unobserved; file watchers were not registered for document disposal.
fix: Capture a stable webview, bind an explicit lifetime to panel disposal and cancellation, drop late messages and CONFIG URI conversion, observe send failures while still surfacing active errors, dispose listeners and document watchers.
method: Actual isolated VS Code profiles and installed production VSIX; 10 ready previews closed, 20 previews closed 25ms after open, final preview reopened, 25s settling wait (beyond AutoEq 20s deadline). Workbench notification MutationObserver starts after the unchanged native timing window and retains transient notices. Tests mute only their editor process audio. No proof of arbitrary race freedom is inferred.
